ann01_permutation_importance.method: permutation importance on a labelled validation cohort

ann01.method: central finite-difference sensitivity with first-order baseline contribution
limitations: Contributions are local first-order approximations, not causal effects.
Correlated astronomical features can share or redistribute apparent importance.

ann02.method: median-baseline region occlusion plus input-gradient sensitivity
limitations: Occlusion measures model sensitivity to replacing a region by normalized median flux; it is not causal astronomy.
Gradient saliency is local and can be unstable in saturated or ReLU-inactive regions.
A high-influence region is not by itself evidence of a planetary transit.
